CVE-2026-53914 affects unsafe deserialization of KAPT incremental build cache metadata. kotlin-stdlib 2.4.0, included through webp-imageio 0.11.0, contains none of the affected KAPT classes. This checkout has no KAPT tasks or configurations; the Kotlin Gradle plugin API used by AspectJ does not enable KAPT. The generic jetbrains:kotlin CPE incorrectly associates this CVE with the stdlib. This is a false-positive suppression, not a mitigation or accepted residual risk. Reassess when the artifact version/content changes or KAPT is introduced, and evaluate any Kotlin build tooling separately from this standard-library artifact. Verified on 2026-10-11 against the resolved JAR and Gradle dependency/task graph. References: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-r937-wjx7-w2jp https://github.com/JetBrains/kotlin/commit/bf51df665b458fda7c3eaf436c4d88dc119d7ec6

CVE-2022-37830 affects stored XSS in the media editor of WebJET CMS before 8.6.896. WebJET AI and WebJET AI Local are separate Java AI libraries, not WebJET CMS releases. Their resolved 2.0.4 JARs do not contain the CMS media editor or MediaDataController. The webjet:webjet_cms CPE is a product mismatch. This rule suppresses only this CVE on these two AI artifacts; it does not suppress findings on WebJET CMS or assert that the CMS media editor is safe. Reassess when the artifact version/content changes or the advisory scope changes. Verified on 2026-10-11 against both resolved JARs and their Maven metadata. References: https://citadelo.com/download/CVE-2022-37830.pdf https://github.com/webjetcms/webjet-ai

CVE-2026-47842: the vendor lists Spring Security Crypto 7.1.1 as the fixed OSS release. The reviewed CMS source and resolved application dependencies do not use AesBytesEncryptor or the deprecated Encryptors factories. This is a version/applicability mismatch, not a claim that upgrading migrates ciphertext written with a legacy encryptor. Reassess if legacy encryption APIs, custom integrations, or previously encrypted data are introduced. Verified on 2026-10-11. Reference: https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47842

CVE-2026-93748 / GHSA-ch52-4w7c-c8xp requires a shared HTTP cache. This dependency is used by make-fetch-happen in the admin build dependency chain, whose lib/cache/policy.js passes shared: false to CacheSemantics. The shared-cache prerequisite is absent in this reviewed use. The maintainer also disputes the advisory, but that dispute alone is not the justification. Reassess if the consumer/configuration changes or a shared proxy cache is added. Verified on 2026-10-11. Reference: https://github.com/kornelski/http-cache-semantics/issues/56

Accepted residual risk, explicitly approved by the project owner on 2026-10-11 after review of CVE-2026-85228; exploitability in this checkout is unconfirmed. DJL 0.36.0 is affected by integer overflow in tensor-buffer size validation. It is pulled in by webjet-ai-local 2.0.4, which is excluded from the standard client distribution. The reviewed local provider uses DJL tokenizers and creates tensors through ONNX Runtime; no attacker-controlled raw DJL tensor endpoint was established. This does not prove the affected code is safe. A coordinated API/tokenizers/SentencePiece upgrade to 0.37.0 remains pending native-runtime compatibility verification. Reassess if local AI is distributed, tensor input or inference engines change, or a reachable DJL tensor path is added. Reference: https://aws.amazon.com/security/security-bulletins/2026-106-aws/

Accepted residual risk, explicitly approved by the project owner on 2026-10-11 for the listed HIGH findings whose exploitability here is unconfirmed. tar 6.2.1 is installed through @webjetcms/tui-image-editor -> fabric -> canvas -> @mapbox/node-pre-gyp 1.0.11. Archive extraction occurs during native-addon installation, not in the CMS request handler or browser image editor. A malicious/compromised installation archive could still cause path traversal, arbitrary file writes or denial of service on the developer/CI machine. CVE-2026-73566 additionally requires a non-empty member-selection list; the reviewed node-pre-gyp extract call passes only cwd, strip and onentry options. This is not a false positive or a security fix. Migration of the parent to node-pre-gyp 2.x and tar 7.5.21 needs native-install compatibility verification; it is deliberately separate from compatible tar 7 patch updates. Reassess when the dependency chain, archive sources, installation environment, or tar usage changes, and remove this exception after the migration. References: https://github.com/isaacs/node-tar/security/advisories https://github.com/mapbox/node-pre-gyp/blob/v2.0.3/package.json

CVE-2026-44311 / GHSA-w22m-hvvm-xmwx requires attacker-controlled gradient colors to be serialized with Fabric toSVG() and the resulting SVG to be rendered as active markup. The CMS integration imports @webjetcms/tui-image-editor 3.15.304 in admin/v9/src/js/image-editor.js and saves raster PNG via toDataURL() in getImageBlob(). Neither the integration nor the editor source calls toSVG(). The npm dependency resolves to Fabric 5.5.2; the editor distribution embeds Fabric 5.2.4. Both copies were reviewed. This is non-applicability in this integration, not a patched library or accepted residual risk. Reassess if SVG export/rendering, untrusted gradient input, custom editor integrations, or the editor/Fabric version changes. Verified on 2026-10-11. Reference: https://github.com/fabricjs/fabric.js/security/advisories/GHSA-w22m-hvvm-xmwx

CVE-2026-19504 concerns server-side resource requests when Fabric loadFromJSON() processes untrusted URLs. CMS uses Fabric only in the browser image editor: admin/v9/src/js/app.js lazy-loads image-editor.js, and the image-editor page loads image URLs. Neither the integration nor the editor source imports attacker-supplied Fabric JSON with loadFromJSON(); there is no server-side Fabric rendering in this reviewed integration. The npm dependency is Fabric 5.5.2 and @webjetcms/tui-image-editor 3.15.304 embeds Fabric 5.2.4. This is non-applicability, not a library fix. Reassess if server-side rendering, Fabric JSON import, custom integrations, or the editor/Fabric version changes. Verified on 2026-10-11. References: https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-26-588/ https://github.com/fabricjs/fabric.js/pull/11064
